write_up: This is a strong payments resume! At Lumen Ledger, you show the payouts service you built, the ledger migration you led and the latency you cut. Those are the kinds of work Cobalt Pay is looking for, with enough detail for a recruiter to understand your part.

The balance API line is a model: it names the change you made and shows the improvement in p99 latency. Your resume also shows Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka and mentoring. It doesn't yet show whether you owned on-call end to end or partnered with Finance and Risk on reconciliation and controls.

Start with the payments runbooks and incident reviews. If you handled on-call duties, add what was yours. Add Finance or Risk work if you've done it, and make any technical design review leadership visible too. Your resume is strong enough that the competition for the role and those specific requirements may matter more than further polishing.
